prompt_text: Cold-review D007. If selected-ending traversal is formally real but still too explanatory, compress the route into a recursive command. Use a seven-layer branch lattice whose selected initials spell `RECURSE`. Make every selected final word three letters long so the modulo-three traversal follows the first omitted candidate in each layer. The route sentence should tell the reader what the machine-native form does: `open it again until you return changed`.
render_title: P0001 draft_008 — Recursive Zero Route / RECURSE
unselected_final_words_claim: open the cut it names you again after selection until closed syntax you leave display return through output changed at source
selector_vector_claim: Selected-line text selectors fetch the 21-word shadow in seven three-word slices; selected final-word lengths all equal zero modulo three and route to the first omitted candidate of each layer.
state_switch_claim: The draft has a closed state and a vector-open state. Opening the apparatus appends shadow triplets; the recursive route uses selected three-letter endings to choose first omitted candidates and generate the command sentence.
traversal_rule: Rule: final selected word length modulo three omitted candidates chooses one omitted candidate from the same layer. In D008 every selected final word has length three, so every route index is zero.
traversal_sentence_claim: open it again until you return changed
ergodic_traversal_claim: The selected surface is a zero-route address machine: every visible ending is three letters long, each route index is 0, and the first omitted candidate in each layer yields 'open it again until you return changed.'
zero_route_claim: All selected final words have length 3; with three omitted candidates per layer, length % 3 = 0 for every layer. This forces a deterministic first-omitted path whose final words spell the recursive command.
reader_switch_claim: The opened poem is recursive rather than appended: its route sentence instructs rereading, and the route exists only after applying the packet rule to the selected surface.
external_pointer: The residue lattice, selector map, selector vector, loss budget, state-switch receipt, ergodic-traversal receipt, and zero-route receipt are required parts of this draft object.
non_claim: This packet validates branch bookkeeping, shadow-word construction, selector-vector construction, state-switch consistency, ergodic traversal, and zero-route consistency only; it is not a poem-quality claim.
disclosure_condition: This draft is machine-authored, branch-generated, packet-rendered, state-switch dependent, and recursive-route dependent. Concealing the machine process removes the route that tells the reader to reopen it.
design_change_from_d007: D007 made the selected ending route formally visible but narratively diffuse. D008 compresses the traversal into a recursive zero-route whose route sentence acts as an instruction rather than a caption.
